title: FRACTAL kernel evidence
description: Structured completion record for one workstream. Graph law: dependents become ready only when this evidence is accepted. Layer 1 rows must carry pasted command output — not a self-assessment.

blueprint.description: BLUEPRINT name or path this evidence closes

accepted.description: Architect (or installer equivalent) accepted this evidence. True is the only signal that unlocks dependents. Not PRD Status.

work_not_completed.description: In-scope items left undone, with reason. Use a single 'None' entry if complete.

technical_debt.description: Shortcuts, TODOs, follow-ups. Use a single 'None' entry if none.

key_decisions.description: Decisions and PRD deviations with rationale

layer1.description: Deterministic gates. Each row must include the command and pasted stdout/stderr.

deviation.description: True when this departed from the PRD

gate.description: lint | build | typecheck | test | or project-specific gate name

output.description: Pasted command output. Self-reported PASS without output is invalid.
